data.name: Panavi
data.gender_notes: Panavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Panavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘पानवि’, which means ‘one who knows everything’ or ‘all-knowing’. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and art. It is a powerful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. The name Panavi carries the meaning “All-knowing, Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Panavi usually hope their child will grow to embody all-knowing, wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
